limiter.firewallAction.limiter_ip_ban.de: Every page and API of the installation refuses the address for a while; never an operator's address.
Lowers the address's request limits for a while.
limiter.firewallHoneytoken.trap_routes.d: Old-looking admin and backup paths that no page links to. They answer like any missing page; whoever asks for one is reported.
limiter.firewallSignal.edge_decision: The edge proxy blocked or challenged a request
limiter.firewallSignal.limiter_address_d: An address's request limit was divided for misbehaving
limiter.firewallSignal.limiter_rate_limi: Requests were refused by a rate limit
limiter.firewallSignal.limiter_trap_rout: A trap route was asked for
limiter.firewallSignal.security_ip_ban_p: An address ban was widened to every page
limiter.permission.limiter_ip_bans_manag: Root tenant only. Ban an address or CIDR block from every page and API of the installation for a while, with a reason, and lift a ban. Every ban and lift is audited.
Ban and unban addresses for the whole installation
limiter.permission.limiter_settings_read: Root tenant only. The sign-in limits, address bans and anonymous API limit of the whole installation.
View the installation's rate limits and bans
limiter.permission.limiter_settings_upda: Root tenant only. Each limit can only be made stricter than the built-in value.
Change the installation's rate limits and bans
limiter.settings.limiterApiPerMinute.des: How many API requests one client address may send a minute without signing in: 30 to 120 (the built-in limit). Signed-in people keep their own limits, and a tenant's plan allowance is not changed.
limiter.settings.limiterApiPerMinute.lab: Anonymous API requests per address (per minute)
limiter.settings.limiterAuthPerMinute.de: How many sign-in, code, captcha and password reset requests one client address may send a minute: 5 to 20 (the built-in limit). A higher value changes nothing.
limiter.settings.limiterBanBaseMinutes.d: How long the first automatic ban of an address lasts; every repeat doubles it, up to 7 days: 60 (the built-in length) to 10080 minutes. A manual ban without a length takes it too.
limiter.settings.limiterLoginPerMinute.d: How many login attempts one client address may make a minute, on top of the limit above: 3 to 10 (the built-in limit). When the server sets a lower login limit, the lower one applies.
How many failed sign-ins from one address, on any accounts, within 10 minutes ban that address: 3 to 10 (the built-in threshold).
Failed sign-ins before an address is banned
limiter.settings.subtitle: Sign-in limits, address bans and anonymous API traffic for the whole installation; each can only be made stricter
limiter.settings.title: Rate Limits and Bans
